observations: White wall-mounted hair dryer with grey accents.
Brand 'MMAAT BATHROOMS' is printed on the body in photo 0 and photo 1.
The device is mounted on a wall bracket with a coiled power cord.
The wall surface behind the dryer shows significant brown staining and discoloration.
The interior of the nozzle is visible in photo 2 and appears to have some residue or buildup.

claims.evidence: The brand is visible, but 'MMAAT quality' is a subjective marketing claim.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or the heating element may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the dryer powered on and successfully drying hair.

risks.risk: The wall mounting bracket may be loose or the screws may have rusted through the wall.
risks.proof: A photo of the bracket with the dryer removed to inspect the wall anchors.

risks.risk: The internal heating chamber may be clogged with hair or debris, reducing efficiency.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the interior of the nozzle and the rear of the motor housing.
risks.if_unproven: as having a clogged or damaged internal chamber

proof_requests: Video of the hair dryer in operation drying hair.
Photo of the rear of the unit showing the power plug and the motor housing.
Photo of the wall mounting bracket with the dryer removed to check the screws.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
